artworks.title: The Union Club
artworks.medium: etching and engraving, hand-colored with watercolor by the publisher
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded banquet room filled with attendees engaging in a celebration. There is a large central table cluttered with bottles, cups, and spilled liquid. Some guests are in humorous postures, with exaggerated poses of inebriation. The atmosphere is chaotic, with flying hats and furniture. An ornate clock is visible on the wall. The scene is detailed and captures a comical essence of a satirical commentary on social behavior.

artworks.title: Cruelty in Perfection
artworks.medium: woodcut on thick laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a chaotic scene in a town at night. The detailed image features people gathered outdoors under a crescent moon. A woman lies on the ground in front of them next to various objects including a lantern, a bag, papers, and bottles. One paper reads, "Here Lieth the Body." The figures show expressions of confusion, panic, or distress with one pointing and others conversing. The background shows a tall brick building, trees, and a distant building. The scene suggests an alarming event among the onlookers.

artworks.title: The Reward of Cruelty
artworks.medium: woodcut on thick laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an anatomical dissection taking place in a lecture theatre. A central figure is performing a dissection on a human body on a round table, surrounded by other figures observing intently. The setting is crowded with onlookers, some in academic attire. In the background, there are skeletal figures on either side and the room is ornately decorated with large windows and a crest above the central area. In the foreground, there are elements such as a dissection instrument, a cauldron with skulls, and a dog sniffing around a bucket.

artworks.title: Chasseur à Cheval (Soldier on Horseback)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse with a rifle across his lap. He wears a dark blue uniform with a military-style cap and a mustache, while a bandolier crosses his chest. In the background, there are several other riders in similar uniforms. The setting is a forest with dense foliage, trees, and grassy terrain.

artworks.title: Design for a Ceiling
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown, blue, yellow and pink wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Seth Fagen, in honor of Vincent Buonanno on his retirement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate ceiling design. The central area features an oval shape filled with intricate geometric and floral patterns. The surrounding sections of the ceiling are adorned with panels that have floral and classical motifs, with a series of oval medallions containing figurative reliefs in blue tones. Detailed depictions of sculptural elements such as cherubs or putti can be seen at the corners. The overall design conveys a sense of elegance and opulence, characteristic of classic architectural interiors, likely intended for an elaborate building such as a palace or a notable house.

artworks.title: Faust Seeing Marguerite for the First Time
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing together with their full bodies in view. In the center, a young woman is holding a book and a rosary, standing upright. She has delicate facial features, long hair pulled back, and wears a long dress with pointed shoes. Beside her is a child holding a book, wearing a knee-length dress and appearing barefoot. Other individuals in the scene include an elderly woman, a middle-aged woman, and several men in period-appropriate attire. The setting appears to be a building with columns and stone steps, with a carved architectural element visible.

artworks.title: The Palace; white and pink
artworks.medium: pastel and conté crayon on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Fund and Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Antique Ruins along a Mountain Coast
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash, edged with pen and black ink
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with ancient ruins depicted in detailed drawings. A classical structure with carvings and columns is on the left, surrounded by trees. In the distance, there are crumbling towers and buildings blending into hillsides. The horizon is not distinct, merging with the cloudy sky. The artwork has fine, detailed brushstrokes, resembling an etching. It uses varying shades of sepia and charcoal, creating an antiqued effect.

artworks.title: A Waterfall by Rock Cliffs
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper, with black ink border
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a landscape with boulders, rocky formations, trees, birds in the sky, and fishermen near a river or stream. The drawing features delicate branches, light brushstrokes, careful shading techniques, and a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Henry IIII, Roy de France
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man wearing regal attire, enclosed within an oval frame with the inscription "Henry IIII, Roy de France et de Navarre." The person is shown from the chest up and facing forward. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent beard and curly hair styled back. He wears a large, ornate crown on his head. The man's clothing is richly decorated, featuring ornate patterns and symbols, including birds and stars. A large, decorative chain is visible around his neck. The background is plain, with no additional elements or scenery present, focusing attention solely on the regal figure. The engraving rests on a larger sheet with engraved text below, adding to the historical and formal presentation of the portrait.

artworks.title: Pierre Noel le Cauchois
artworks.artist: Louis-Jacques Cathelin, after Marie Therese Noireterre
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man in a portrait within an oval frame. He has light-colored, wavy hair and a pointed nose, wears a formal jacket with a high collar and a cravat. The frame has detailed decoration, with scattered sheets of paper below the portrait. The background is textured. Inscriptions at the top and bottom of the image provide his name and titles.

artworks.title: Maximilianus II
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14 × 10.2 cm (5 1/2 × 4 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure on a horse in an engraving. The person is seated upright on the horse, which is shown mid-stride. The man has facial features that include a beard, mustache, and short styled hair. He is dressed in armor with a cape, and holds a baton. The horse is decorated with a feathered plume. The background shows buildings, domes, and towers, along with smaller figures in motion. The name "MAXIMILIANVS. II" is inscribed above, with text below.

artworks.title: The Artist in His Mother's Room, Danzig
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with detailed shadows and lighting. The artwork features a dimly lit room with a window that allows light to stream in, casting intricate shadows across a wooden floor. A table with ornate details and high-backed chairs emphasizes the quiet and intimate setting, while a tablecloth drapes elegantly on a piece of furniture in the background. The contrast between light and dark areas, along with visible brushwork and textural details, create a sense of depth within the scene.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Two Children
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 23.6 × 18.9 cm (9 5/16 × 7 7/16 in.) [trimmed within platemark]
mount: 41.9 × 27.7 cm (16 1/2 × 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures and a baby. One figure is a woman walking to the right, carrying a swaddled baby across her chest and holding a walking stick. The woman's head is covered with a shawl, and her facial features appear focused downward. She is dressed in a long dress and a cloak. Next to her is a child walking. The child wears a hood and holds a round object in front of their body. Their facial expression is somber, and they are wearing a long coat. The background includes a tree with detailed bark and branches with leaves, along with shrubs and distant hills.

artworks.title: Shepherd Boy with Sheep
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 24 × 18.5 cm (9 7/16 × 7 5/16 in.) [trimmed within platemark]
mount: 43 × 28.4 cm (16 15/16 × 11 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a shepherd standing on grassy terrain and a rod resting on his shoulder. Closest to the shepherd, several sheep are resting on the ground. The shepherd is dressed in countryside attire, including a hat and a vest, looking into the distance. To the side, there is a small bush and shrubbery. The horizon is low, suggesting a wide-open landscape with distant hills or terrain. In the distance, another figure is seen riding. The style consists of fine lines and stippling in monochromatic tones of muted grays and blues, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Boy and Girl with a Donkey
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 23.7 × 18 cm (9 5/16 × 7 1/16 in.) [trimmed within platemark]
mount: 43.5 × 28.2 cm (17 1/8 × 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person riding a donkey while another follows on foot. The scene is set in a rustic environment, depicting a person riding a donkey and another figure walking alongside. The seated figure is gesturing towards something. In the background, there is a tree. The animals and figures are detailed with attention to texture and shading. The drawing is executed on textured paper.

artworks.title: Woman Spinning Yarn by an Arch
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
shee (trimmed within platemark): 23.4 × 18 cm (9 3/16 × 7 1/16 in.) 
mount: 43.2 × 27.9 cm (17 × 11 in.)
artworks.description: A woman stands holding a spindle in her right hand, extending her left hand towards a goat nearby. She has a delicate profile with her hair pulled back, wearing a long-sleeved dress with a sash tied around her waist and fabric draped over her right shoulder. Several sheep rest at her feet. The scene is set against a rustic stone archway partially covered in leafy branches.

artworks.title: Shepherd Playing a Flute with Goats
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 23.5 × 18.2 cm (9 1/4 × 7 3/16 in.) [trimmed with platemark]
mount: 43.3 × 28.4 cm (17 1/16 × 11 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with two goats in the forefront, a third goat standing behind them, and a shepherd playing a flute. The style features precise brushstrokes to render the fur texture of the goats and delicate lines defining the elements. The color palette consists of gray tones on a blue-toned paper. In the background, tall trees are visible behind a rocky outcrop, framing the central elements.

artworks.title: Shepherd Boy Speaking to a Farm Girl
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 23.4 × 18 cm (9 3/16 × 7 1/16 in.) [trimmed within platemark]
mount: 44 × 26 cm (17 5/16 × 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a donkey and two figures next to a building. The central focus is on the donkey, with a ladder against a stone wall in the background. The drawing depicts a pastoral or rural setting with detailed textures in the fabrics, fur of the donkey, and the stone wall. The scene conveys a sense of everyday life through the interaction and poses of the figures.

artworks.title: View of the Grotto by Heilbrunn, near Salzburg
artworks.medium: aquatint printed in brown with white heightening, on original mount with engraved title affixed
artworks.description: The image shows a natural rock archway with foliage growing on it. In the foreground there are rocks and sparse vegetation. A small urn is seen under the archway, and a cloaked figure is pointing towards the scene. The rocks and foliage are depicted in shades of brown, with darker tones for shadows and lighter tones for sunlit areas. The background displays more rocks reaching up to a sky with a few clouds. The color scheme is primarily earthy browns, giving the image an antique look.

artworks.title: Max Klinger
artworks.medium: etching and roulette printed in orange on buff laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is in profile, facing towards the right side. He has a strong facial structure with a prominent chin and a full beard. His hair is short and groomed. He wears glasses with circular lenses. The clothing is suggested with minimalist lines, possibly a jacket or formal attire. The background is plain, directing attention to the man in the portrait.

artworks.title: Porch before a Circular Temple
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with classic elements. The image shows a room with high, arched ceilings and various architectural embellishments. There is a large statue at the top of a staircase in the center, under a domed ceiling with square-paneled motifs. Niches on both sides of the room contain additional architectural details and decorations. In the foreground, several small figures appear to be conversing. The structure is upheld by columns, and light creates contrasts between the shaded and illuminated areas, emphasizing the room's depth.

artworks.title: La France Libératrice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with monoprint inking on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a drummer standing on an elevated surface surrounded by figures. The setting includes a crowd of people below and floating figures above holding various items. The scene is framed with detailed etching techniques.

artworks.title: Dames en Manteaux
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. The person on the left is a woman facing the viewer, wearing a cap and holding a hand fan. In the center, a man stands confidently with one foot forward, wearing a wig and holding a cane. On the right, a woman is shown from behind, holding a closed fan. Their clothing is detailed and intricate, set against a plain background.
